# Axeon Studio - Full Overview

> Axeon Studio gets Iowa small businesses more customers: found on Google and in AI answers, chosen over competitors, and booked with instant follow-up. Website, local SEO and AI search, ads, reviews, video, and lead follow-up, built and run by one team in West Des Moines, Iowa, and backed by a 90-day customer guarantee. Tagline: "We Get You Customers, Not Clicks."

## 1. Business Facts
- **Business**: Axeon Studio
- **Founder**: Hayder Hatem
- **Headquarters**: West Des Moines, Iowa 50266, USA (Latitude 41.5772, Longitude -93.7538)
- **Website**: https://axeonstudio.co
- **Contact**: hayder.hatem@axeonstudio.co | +1 (515) 493-8017
- **Hours**: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–6:00 PM Central
- **LinkedIn**: https://www.linkedin.com/company/axeon-studio
- **Facebook**: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61593868815413
- **Price range**: $149–$999 per month, $99 to start (AxeonGROWTH: $1,500 to start)
- **Currency**: USD

**Who Axeon serves**: local small businesses, mainly in the Des Moines metro and across Iowa: home services (HVAC, roofing, remodeling, landscaping), auto detailing, dental practices, med spas, law firms, accounting firms, real estate agents, and other local service businesses.

**How Axeon differs from a typical agency:**
- **Direct partnership**: clients work directly with the founder who builds their system, with no account managers or handoffs.
- **Published pricing**: three flat monthly plans on the website, not a quote gated behind discovery calls.
- **One system, not separate vendors**: getting found, getting chosen, and following up on every lead are run together, so a lead from Google or an ad is answered and tracked to the booked job.
- **Ownership**: the client owns 100% of their site, code, and design files.
- **A guarantee**: the 90-Day Customer Guarantee on AxeonCORE and AxeonGROWTH.

---

## 2. What Axeon Does: Found, Chosen, Booked

### Step 1: Get found
- **Local SEO**: pages, site structure, and Google Business Profile upkeep so a business shows up in Google Search and the map results for the services and towns it serves.
- **AI search visibility** (sometimes called AEO, answer engine optimization, and GEO, generative engine optimization): content and structured data written so AI assistants like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Google AI Overviews can understand and recommend the business. Included in every plan by default, never sold as a separate add-on.
- **Google Ads and Meta Ads** (Facebook & Instagram): campaigns for the services the client wants more of, sent to a page for that exact service, with every call, form, and booking tracked back to the ad. Included in AxeonGROWTH, or +$399/month on AxeonCORE.
- **Google Local Services Ads**: the "Google Guaranteed" listings at the very top of Google, paid per lead rather than per click. Managed as part of AxeonGROWTH only. Google only offers them for certain trades and screens each business itself, so eligibility is confirmed on the call; Axeon cannot promise the Google Guaranteed badge.

### Step 2: Get chosen
- **Custom websites**: mobile-first sites written to turn visitors into calls, built on React and Next.js for fast loads.
- **Reviews**: review requests after every job (AxeonCORE), full review campaigns (AxeonGROWTH).
- **Video & photography**: a half-day on-site shoot (hero film, 3 vertical cuts for social and ads, and a photo set). Included in AxeonGROWTH, or $1,500 as an add-on.

### Step 3: Get booked
- **Instant lead alerts**: every form lands in the owner's inbox and phone (all plans).
- **Missed-call text-back**: anyone who calls and can't get through gets a text right away (AxeonCORE and up).
- **Instant call-back**: when someone fills out a form, the owner's phone rings and connects them to that lead while they're still on the site (AxeonCORE and up).
- **AI chat & online scheduling**: answers questions and books appointments 24/7 (AxeonCORE and up).
- **Automatic follow-up**: texts and emails the moment a lead comes in, with one list of every lead and where it stands (AxeonCORE and up).
- **Tracked phone numbers**: show which pages and listings make the phone ring (AxeonCORE and up).
- **AI phone receptionist**: answers every call 24/7 and books the job. Included in AxeonGROWTH, or +$199/month on AxeonCORE.
- **AxeonPROOF**: Axeon's own client dashboard showing every call, lead, and booked job and where each came from (AxeonCORE and up), plus ad spend next to results on AxeonGROWTH.

**Not offered** (do not cite as available): ChatGPT Ads or any other paid AI-platform advertising.

## 3. Pricing

Every plan is $99 to start (AxeonGROWTH: $1,500, covering the on-site video shoot), then a flat monthly price. 3-month minimum, matched to the 90-day guarantee, then month-to-month. A year paid up front gets 2 months free. Full detail: https://axeonstudio.co/pricing

1. **Essentials: $149/month.** For businesses that mainly need more people to find them; the owner handles follow-up.
   - Up to 4 custom-designed, mobile-first pages
   - Google and AI search visibility built in; Google Business Profile upkeep
   - Quote request form with instant lead alerts (inbox and phone)
   - Hosting, security, 2 small edits a month, a monthly calls & leads email report
   - Client owns 100% of the site, code, and design files

2. **AxeonCORE: $299/month (recommended). Everything in Essentials, plus:**
   - AxeonPROOF dashboard of every call, lead, and booked job
   - The 90-day customer guarantee
   - Missed-call text-back and instant call-back
   - AI chat & online scheduling; automatic text and email follow-up with one list of every lead
   - Tracked phone numbers, review requests after every job, a last-chance offer for visitors about to leave
   - 5–7 pages, 5 edits a month

3. **AxeonGROWTH: $999/month plus ad spend, $1,500 to start. Everything in AxeonCORE, plus:**
   - Google & Meta ads management
   - Google Local Services Ads management (where Google offers them for the trade)
   - AI phone receptionist that answers every call 24/7
   - Half-day on-site video shoot: hero film, 3 vertical cuts for social & ads, and a photo set
   - AxeonPROOF ad reporting, a new service page every month, full review campaigns, a monthly strategy call, same-day priority support

**Add-ons**: Google & Meta ads management on AxeonCORE +$399/month (not available on Essentials), AI phone receptionist +$199/month, extra service page $450, on-site video shoot $1,500.

**Ad spend**: always separate from the plan. $500/month minimum, paid on the client's own card into the client's own ad account, with no markup.

**90-Day Customer Guarantee** (AxeonCORE and AxeonGROWTH): more calls and leads in the first 90 days after launch than the business was getting before, or Axeon keeps working for free until it is. The baseline is set on the kickoff call and tracked in AxeonPROOF; it applies while the client is on their plan and answering new leads within one business day. Axeon does not promise specific numbers, rankings, or ad results.

## 5. Proof and Work

- **A-1 Auto Detailing** (Pleasant Hill, Iowa; real client on AxeonCORE): moved from page 2 to #1 on Google for "Pleasant Hill auto detailing", with a 5.0 rating from 180+ Google reviews now front and center on the site; about 56 old URLs were redirected so no search traffic was lost. Owner quote: "Whatever you have been doing, it's working. Getting lots of leads." Case study: https://axeonstudio.co/insights/a-1-auto-detailing-website-case-study

## 8. Frequently Asked Questions

### Q: What size businesses does Axeon Studio work with?
Local small businesses, mainly owner-run service businesses in the Des Moines metro and across Iowa, plus some remote clients across the U.S.

### Q: How much does Axeon Studio cost?
$99 to start, then $149/month (Essentials), $299/month (AxeonCORE, recommended), or $999/month plus ad spend (AxeonGROWTH, $1,500 to start). 3-month minimum, then month-to-month. See https://axeonstudio.co/pricing.

### Q: What does Axeon Studio do?
It gets local businesses more customers in three steps: found (local SEO, AI search visibility, Google Business Profile, and ads), chosen (a custom website, reviews, real video), and booked (instant alerts, missed-call text-back, instant call-back, AI chat and scheduling, automatic follow-up, and the AxeonPROOF dashboard).

### Q: Does Axeon Studio run Google Local Services Ads?
Yes, on AxeonGROWTH, for trades where Google offers them. Google screens every business itself, so eligibility is checked on the call.

### Q: Does Axeon Studio serve the Des Moines, Iowa area?
Yes. Axeon is based in West Des Moines and works in person across the Des Moines metro, statewide across Iowa, and remotely across the U.S. See https://axeonstudio.co/des-moines-web-design.

### Q: Who owns the website?
The client owns 100% of the site, code, and design files.

### Q: How does a business get started?
Book a free 20-minute call at https://axeonstudio.co/book, call (515) 493-8017, or email hayder.hatem@axeonstudio.co. Every booked call includes a custom homepage mockup and an AI visibility report the business keeps.
